## Questions checked against existing decisions

Q-R-1, Q-R-2, Q-R-3 and Q-A-601 are already answered in owning specs: implement them, do not
reopen. A02 now exists; its evaluated baseline supplies ordinary hero facts. The Q-A-200 bridge is explicitly temporary: retire its runtime override when an evaluated baseline exists. Existing supplied-fact rows must never replace admitted characteristics, kits or ability grants. Critical opportunity
lifetime and deferred unique resource reuse remain described as limited/manual; no new question is
needed to repair the supported common path.

Additional source read before baseline integration: SC `kit/mountain.md` prints Pain for Pain as
Main action, Melee/Strike/Weapon, Might or Agility, tiers `3 / 5 / 13 + M or A`, plus a conditional
Effect. SC `chapter/kits.md` (also quoted in R04 4.2) explicitly includes kit damage in its own
signature. Expose this granted ability with the existing common tier parser; record the conditional
bonus as manual, without adding the Mountain tier bonus a second time.

## Repairs

- Confirmed natural precedence and healing cap no longer emit obsolete uncertainty labels. Damage
  defaults independently; `damage-characteristic=` is exposed by the same shared command, pending
  selection and UI, accepts a permitted choice or `default`, and is retained through corrections.
  Switching ability clears incompatible roll/damage choices.
- Fixed costs are checked before either rolled or manual-effect execution, and debited once in the
  same journaled command. Effect-only source actions do not receive free execution. Unknown costs
  remain manual. Ferocity waiver requires a known matching pool and warns that reuse/lifecycle checks
  remain manual. Extra main action uses do not consume the ordinary action counter twice. Off-turn
  triggered actions do not receive an ordinary-turn-only warning.
- A02 reviewed baselines supply all granted abilities and arithmetic facts; obsolete heroRollFacts
  rows cannot override them. The legacy `/hero facts` route refuses admitted evaluated heroes. The
  Mountain signature is read from its own printed section, with the kit bonus already included and
  its conditional extra damage left manual.
- Foe uses read their loaded snapshot, not a subsequently reseeded catalog. Used-action source
  contains only the actual ability block; private stat blocks are not attached as public support.
  Peers cannot query full unused hero/foe ability sheets. Malice-bearing and correction events provide
  explicit public descriptions for the root-owned shared audience projector.
- The effective ability row privately stores original resolution inputs. Corrections retain those
  accepted facts, dice and explicit damage choice rather than rereading a later build. Legacy rows
  without that snapshot cannot be silently recomputed from current facts. Historical targets resolve
  restoration aliases without rewriting the original event. Manual dispositions and their UI use
  the root-owned matching history/session/continuation window.

## Verification

`pnpm exec vitest run --project engine tests/resolve.test.ts --project app tests/app/abilities.test.ts`
passed **36 tests** (19 pure, 17 persisted app). Owned-file ESLint, web TypeScript compilation, and relative-link checks passed. Fresh review found a numerical-mode effective-result projection exposing temporary foe pools; fixed and covered by the 17th persisted app test. Tests assert the actual
journal/live state, baseline-driven signature damage (15, not 19), no stale-fact override, once-only
payment with unchanged dice/surges for a manual effect, independent damage choice/correction/reset,
source snapshot stability and conservative unknown-immunity fallback. The effect-only Make Peace
regression uses an explicitly isolated sourced baseline fixture; it does not claim the minimal
wizard supports that build option.

Fresh independent implementation/rules review and root-coordinated full checks, deployment,
browser/visual verification remain required; this implementer record is not that sign-off.

Fresh review follow-up still assigned to root: batch history-window reads for the result list so each
row does not reload the full campaign/session history. The root-owned event audience projector and
full live/browser integration remain separately reviewed work.
